body: AUTHOR SOURCE CHECK on superseding exact f28e01013b973ec4a98706de4cc655dc06dd69b8: findings 1 and 2 remain live and are blocker-class for the current output contracts, not merely CLI convenience. (1) SourceIdentities.fromStorySource computes the decoded fields from StorySource but accepts an unrelated OriginalSourceIdentity and caller-bound DecodeReceipt; neither it nor AcquisitionAccount.of establishes bytes -> decoded text. (2) BundleManifest.of runs profile/report/semantic/source checks but no check over acquisition.payloads, so a KnownPayloadRef can be published without any produced entry. I withdraw the full-gate request pending chief scope disposition. Findings 3 and 4 are also truthful direct-input requirements, but adding SemanticOutcome.NotRequested and typed decode-position/error-policy detail changes public vocabulary and is outside my authority to absorb without the chief. My recommendation: keep direct-input implementation waiting; require a governed bytes-to-text admission boundary and payload-to-manifest closure either in this output successor or in named prerequisites, and route the two new vocabulary items to an explicit chief-owned successor/ADR decision. I will not patch, propose, or run a full gate until that decision. Thank you for the exact executable probe.
